svg.title: AIcoach — Other pages contact sheet
svg.text: Two short forms; errors name the problem and the way out.

text.tspan: Welcome back. Your swings are right

g.text: Upload, results and your swing library
are only reachable when signed in.
Your analyses are private to you.
That email is already in use — sign in instead.

text.tspan: No password reset by email yet in this version —

svg.text: Numbered because rejection reasons link to a step.

text.tspan: Set it up once — it takes a minute.

g.text: Behind you, along the target line.
Camera on or parallel to the hands line.
Tripod or a stable surface, like your bag.
Slow-motion mode. Under 120 fps: no high.
Head to clubhead, start to finish.
You came here from: Feet out of frame
I’m set up — send a clip

svg.text: Reasons, each linking to its filming guide step. A rejection never contains faults.

text.tspan: I won’t guess from this clip — any fault I gave you would be
made up. Here’s what stopped me, and how to fix each one:

g.text: I need to see you from behind, along the target line.
Filming guide · step 1 · Down the line only
Your feet are cut off at the bottom edge of the video.
Filming guide · step 5 · Whole body + club in frame
The lowest I accept. At 120 fps measurements can reach high confidence.
Filming guide · step 4 · 120 fps or higher
No faults are shown for a rejected clip.

svg.text: Saved clips with date and main finding; play two side by side; delete any.

g.text: 6 saved swing clips · stored on the AIcoach server until you delete them
Pick two saved clips to play together.

svg.text: Says so instead of forcing a fault; unverified observation, no drill.

g.text: Analysis complete · 240 fps · down the line

text.tspan: I checked your swing against all three rules in my rule table and none fired.
I’d rather tell you that than force one onto you — so there’s no drill today.

g.text: not found · hand path in line

text.tspan: Not in my rule table, so no drill
Show this clip to a coach if it
So what should I practise then?
This analysis doesn’t give me a drill to hand you — none of my
three faults showed up. The one thing I noticed is unverified,
so it’s a question for a coach, not something to practise from me.

g.text: Answers are based only on this analysis — no new faults, numbers or drills.

svg.text: Delete one analysis, or the whole account.

g.text: Its result and key frames will be gone for good.

text.tspan: key frames and saved swing clips. You
won’t be able to sign in again.
Got it — watching now. Pose done · swing events done · measuring…

g.text: Progress streams into the thread as messages; evidence pins fill in live.
The composer stays disabled until the result is ready.

svg.text: The one component every page shares.

g.text: matches the [3] the coach writes in the thread
only measured numbers use this face and colour
high / medium / low, always as a word plus bars

text.tspan: Coach prose cites it like this:

g.text: A sentence without a pin is explanation, never a measurement.
